title: The cold dinner
premise: Daughter skips dinner for a deadline and says she'll just sleep; Mummy says Ok, then reveals paneer is already arriving at her PG, paid.

script.text: Then who will eat the paneer arriving at your PG in 5 minutes.
Paid. Don't tell Papa I used his card.

caption: mummy paid already

post.caption: She said ok and then ordered paneer. Send this to your mumma who never lets you sleep hungry.
